description:
Get multi-factor target prioritisation scores.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table target_prioritisation — one record = one gene's target-prioritisation factors.
Key: targetId.
Arguments: target_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Prioritisation factors for genes OT 25.09 scored; a null factor means not assessed, never 0.
hasSafetyEvent: -1 = a safety event is recorded, null = none recorded or not assessed (no 0 is stored)
maxClinicalTrialPhase is normalised to 0-1 in this table (0.25 per phase), not 0-4

target_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
